title: Remote international hire compliance and asynchronous onboarding playbook
author: Maya Patel
body:
Overview
-----
This playbook standardizes hiring and onboarding for remote employees based outside the company headquarters country. It combines legal/compliance checklists with an asynchronous-first onboarding program designed to keep time-to-productivity predictable across timezones and employment models (W-2, contractor, local entity). Use this as the canonical reference for managers, people-ops partners, and IT for international hires.

Scope and applicability
-----
- Applies to all full-time employees, contractors, and temps hired to work primarily outside the HQ country, starting 2027-01-01 forward.
- Excludes short-term business travelers (< 90 days) whose onboarding follows standard HQ processes.
- Covers: offer acceptance, local compliance (tax/payroll/benefits), device & access provisioning, manager-led role onboarding, and first 6-month performance rhythm.

Objectives
-----
1. Ensure 100% legal and payroll compliance before first invoice/pay run.
2. Reduce mean engineering ramp-time to 60 calendar days for ICs via asynchronous learning and milestone-based enablement.
3. Maintain >90% new-hire satisfaction with onboarding experience (survey metric).
4. Provide managers with a repeatable, low-lift process for distributed hires.

Roles & ownership (quick reference)
-----
| Area | Primary owner | Secondary owner | SLA |
|---|---|---|---|
| Employment verification & contract setup | People Ops (International) | Legal | 7 business days from accepted offer |
| Payroll & local benefits enrollment | Finance / Payroll | People Ops | First payroll cycle (<= 30 days) |
| Device & VPN provisioning | IT / Eng Infra | Hiring manager | Device delivered within 5 business days of start |
| Role onboarding & success plan | Hiring manager | Peer mentor | 90-day plan published by Day 3 |
| Security & compliance training | Security | People Ops | Completion required within 7 calendar days |

Hiring & compliance checklist (pre-start)
-----
1. Confirm employment model (employee vs contractor) with Legal + Finance. If contractor, complete contractor risk assessment form (link to /confluence/policies/contractor-risk).
2. Localize offer template: replace HQ-specific benefits language with country-specific benefits snippet (People Ops maintains country snippets).
3. Initiate background checks if required by local law; track via HRIS case ID.
4. Set up payroll entity or third-party payroll (ADP/local provider). Confirm tax withholding and statutory benefits enrollment.
5. Verify work authorization & visa needs; create Visa Sponsorship ticket when required.
6. Create user record in HRIS and assign onboarding checklist.
7. Notify IT for device procurement and regional power adaptors; select remote delivery vendor if needed.

Pre-boarding (recommended timeline)
-----
- T-minus 7 days (or on acceptance): send personalized welcome packet (see template). Include: 1) role-specific onboarding schedule; 2) security policy summary; 3) teammate introductions and timezone-adapted meeting windows.
- T-minus 5 days: IT creates accounts and schedules device shipment.
- T-minus 3 days: Manager publishes 90-day success plan with measurable milestones.

Day 1 checklist (asynchronous-first)
-----
1. Welcome message from hiring manager (asynchronous template below).
2. New hire completes HR intake forms and confirms payroll setup.
3. Security training enrollment email triggered; must be completed in 7 days.
4. Peer mentor assignment and first asynchronous "welcome thread" started in Slack with timezone pin.
5. Manager schedules two 1:1s: an in-person/real-time kick-off within first week (calendar options provided) and a 30-minute weekly sync for the first month (can be async notes for timezone differences).

Week 1-4: structured asynchronous ramp plan
-----
- Week 1: Orientation modules (self-paced) + role-specific reading list. Objectives: environment bootstrapped, local benefits confirmed, first small deliverable scoped.
- Week 2: Shadowing sequences and pairing tasks. Objective: ship a small change or documentation update.
- Week 3: Take ownership of a clear ticket; manager reviews async checkpoint (template).
- Week 4: Manager conducts a documented 30-day review using the 30-day rubric; collect feedback via anonymous pulse form.

90-day success plan template (manager responsibility)
-----
- Outcome A: Technical onboard - build and deploy a change end-to-end.
- Outcome B: Cross-team collaboration - present a short demo to a partner team.
- Outcome C: Culture & process - complete two onboarding rotations (support, triage).
- Assessment method: evidence artifacts (PR links, deck link) + manager scorecard.

Asynchronous communication patterns & templates
-----
- Welcome message (manager template):
  "Hi {{name}}, welcome to Redwood Inference! I've added you to the #team channel and assigned {{mentor}} as your peer mentor. Please complete the preboarding checklist and mark any scheduling constraints in the attached calendar. Your 90-day plan is published here: {{link}}. I'm excited to work with you — please drop any questions to this thread and I'll respond within 24 hours (unless timezone exception noted)."

- Async weekly check-in template (for manager or mentor):
  - "Wins this week"
  - "Blockers / asks"
  - "Planned work next week"
  - "Support needed from manager/teams"

Tools, templates and CLI examples
-----
- HRIS: use PeopleHub (internal) to track case IDs. Example command to export new hire checklist:
  curl -X GET 'https://peoplehub.internal/api/onboardings?status=pending' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
- Device provisioning ticket in Jira: PROJECT = IT-DEV, issue-type = "Onboard Device". Summary: "Device for {{name}} (country: {{country}})". Field: "Delivery SLA" = 5 days.
- Onboarding plan YAML (example snippet):
  ---
  new_hire: "name"
  manager: "alice@example.com"
  mentor: "bob@example.com"
  start_date: "2029-03-01"
  artifacts: ["PR links", "demo deck"]

Performance & feedback cadence for remote international hires
-----
1. 30-day async checkpoint (manager): checklist completion, environment metrics, first deliverable evidence.
2. 60-day milestone review (manager + peer mentor): deeper competency assessment and ID of any training gaps.
3. 90-day formal calibration (manager + people-ops partner): assign pass/needs-development/extended-ramp. If extended-ramp chosen, produce a 30-day remediation plan.
4. Ongoing: monthly async progress notes for months 4-6; skip to standard quarterly review after month 6 unless remediation active.

Metrics and SLOs
-----
- Payroll & compliance setup: 100% by first payroll run, target SLA 30 days.
- Device delivery SLA: 90% delivered within 5 business days of start.
- Security training completion: 90% within 7 calendar days.
- Ramp time target: median days-to-first-meaningful-PR = 60 days for IC roles.
- New hire NPS (onboarding survey): target >= 40 at 30 days.

Manager escalation and risk signals
-----
Escalate to People Ops when any of the following are true:
- Payroll not confirmed 10 days after start.
- New hire has no working device after 7 days.
- New hire reports unresolved compliance or legal questions.
- Survey score < 20 at 30-day pulse.

Country-specific notes and common pitfalls
-----
- EU hires: confirm data transfer mechanism (SCCs or adequacy decision). Add privacy note to offer packet.
- India hires: statutory benefits include EPF and ESIC where applicable; coordinate with local payroll provider on contribution proofs.
- Brazil hires: local mandatory labor clauses require specific contract language; consult Legal before sending offers.

Rollout checklist for adopting teams (product/engineering managers)
-----
1. Read this playbook and acknowledge in People Ops intake form.
2. Start using templates in the first international hire for your team and share feedback.
3. Invite People Ops to 30- and 90-day calibration meetings for first two international hires.

Appendices
-----
A. Quick message templates (Slack + email)
B. 30/60/90 assessment rubric (scoring guidance)
C. Links to country snippets and legal checklist (People Ops maintained)

Revision history
-----
- 2027-08-15: Created by Maya Patel (initial draft).
- 2028-11-02: Added EU data-transfer guidance (review by Legal).
- 2029-02-10: Reworked async templates and updated device SLA targets (reviewers: Diego Ramos, Lina Hassan, Priya Narang).

If you are a manager preparing to hire internationally, bookmark this page and complete the intake form at /confluence/people-ops/new-international-hire-intake. For urgent compliance questions, contact people-ops-international@redwood.com."
